confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors are based on aggregator and travel-guide price data (Numbeo, whereandwhen.net, citycost.org, and an Oradea guide), which vary in date and method. Cocktail and wine anchors are weaker: they lean on nightlife guides and on the local beer-to-drink relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context, not checked against live listings. The FX figure (0.6720 for 2026-11-18) came from a secondary aggregator that reported it as the RBA 4 pm rate; I could not open the rba.gov.au F11.1 table to confirm it, so the source_url is the RBA page I was directed to rather than one I verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Romanian mid-sized tourist city; price basis drawn from Romanian city guides and aggregator data for Brasov and Oradea, with Bucharest used as a cross-check for cocktail and wine levels.
